stem.text: The graph shows the successive ionisation energies of element X and element Y.

stem.alt: Graph of successive ionisation energies (energy against successive ionisation energies 1 to 10) for element X (dashed line) and element Y (solid line), with a key identifying each line.

A.text: An atom of element X needs one extra electron for a full outer shell; an atom of element Y needs three extra electrons for a full outer shell.

B.text: An atom of element Y has five electrons in the 3p subshell.

C.text: Element X has an oxidation number of +7 in most of its compounds.

D.text: When element X combines with element Y, the bonding is ionic.
